posts.title: Old School characters are treasure hunters, not adventurers
posts.description: It's common for me to see debates against Gold for XP with arguments like "that reward mechanism turns characters into murderhobos" or "characters become amoral and cynical, valuing money more than the lives of their Henchmen or citizens." posts.title: Monetary Worldbuilding
posts.description: Gold pieces, credits, Argentine pesos, whatever you call it, money is always a reward in itself and a stable, easy concept to grasp across most media. Because of this, when we make even little changes to how it functions, we can deliver an authentic and fresh vision to our worlds. What IS your money?
